title: In ConnectWise Automate versions prior to 2026.11, a condition in Web Control Center (WCC2) authorization handling…
description: ConnectWise Automate versions prior to 2026.11 contain an authorization handling flaw in the Web Control Center (WCC2) component. This flaw allows an authenticated contact user to access information related to other clients on the same server via API requests, leading to unauthorized information disclosure. The vulnerability does not permit modification or command execution beyond the user's assigned permissions. The issue is fixed in version 2026.11.
